article_content: Erling Haaland will miss Norway’s final Euro 2024 qualifying match against Scotland after sustaining a foot injury during a friendly against the Faroe Islands, team doctor Ola Sand announced on Saturday. The Manchester City striker, who has scored six goals in the qualifiers — the most for Norway — is experiencing significant pain and reduced function, making him unfit to play in Sunday’s Group A fixture in Glasgow. Although the injury is not considered serious, the timing of the match leaves insufficient recovery time, according to Dr. Sand. Norway has already secured qualification for Euro 2024, placing third in Group A behind Spain and Scotland. However, they remain eligible for the playoffs if results favor them. Coach Stale Solbakken confirmed Haaland will not be substituted, emphasizing the importance of preserving his fitness for potential playoff matches. This season, Haaland has netted 13 goals in club competition, remaining the top scorer in Europe’s major leagues.

Takım doktoru Ola Sand, Cumartesi günü yaptığı açıklamada bunu duyurdu. Küme sıralamasında Norveç'in en çok golünü atan ve elemelerde 6 gol bulunan Manchester City forveti, şiddetli ağrı ve hareket kısıtlılığı nedeniyle Pazar günü Glasgow'da oynanacak Grup A maçına hazır değil. Yaralanmanın ciddi olmadığı belirtilse de, maçın bu kadar erken tarihli olması iyileşmek için yeterli süre bırakmıyor, diye Dr. Sand açıkladı. Norveç, İspanya ve İskoçya'nın ardından grubun üçüncü sırada yer alarak Avrupa Şampiyonluğu'na zaten katılmış durumda. Ancak sonuçlar olumlu yönde gelişirse play-off'lara kalma şansı hâlâ mevcut. Bu sezonda Haaland, kulüp düzeyinde 13 gol atarak Avrupa'nın önde gelen liglerinin en yüksek golcüsü konumunda.

article_content: In a move echoing Cold War-era tactics, Russia has barred American journalist and author David Satter from re-entering the country — a rare and significant step against a foreign correspondent. Satter, who once reported for the Financial Times and has written extensively on post-Soviet Russia, was serving as an adviser to Radio Free Europe and Radio Liberty when he was denied a visa renewal in Kiev. He was told his presence in Russia was deemed 'undesirable,' a phrase typically used in espionage cases. Satter, now in London, insists he followed every bureaucratic requirement, including timelines provided by Russian diplomats. The Russian Foreign Ministry claims he violated migration law by waiting five days to apply for a multi-entry visa after arriving on November 21, calling his stay 'illegal.' He was fined and ordered to leave by a Moscow court on November 29, departing on December 4, and now faces a five-year ban. Satter rejects these allegations outright, saying the real reason for his expulsion is his long-standing criticism of President Putin — particularly his warnings that Sochi, host of the upcoming Winter Olympics, was effectively a 'war zone' following terrorist attacks in Volgograd. He noted the chilling similarity between the language used against him and Soviet-era repression, calling the move unprecedented for a journalist. While Russia insists such bans are common — citing over 500,000 foreigners barred for rule-breaking — observers see this as a deliberate signal to deter critical reporting. Satter hopes for reversal but acknowledges the odds are slim. His case, he warns, sends a message to all foreign journalists: honest coverage of Russia now carries a heavy price.
translated_content: Rusya, Amerikalı gazeteci ve yazar David Satter'ı ülkeye yeniden girmekten yasaklayarak Soğuk Savaş dönemi taktiklerine benzer bir adım attı — bu, yabancı bir muhabir karşıtı nadiren görülen önemli bir hamle. Satter, bir zamanlar Financial Times için çalışmış ve post-Sovyet Rusyası üzerine geniş ölçüde yazılmış yazar, Radio Free Europe ve Radio Liberty için danışmanlık yaparken Kiev'de vizesinin reddedilmesiyle karşılaştı. Rusya'daki varlığının 'istenmeyen' olduğu söylendi; bu ifade genellikle casusluk davalarında kullanılır. Şimdi Londra'da olan Satter, Rus diplomatların verdiği talimatları tamamen yerine getirdiğini savunuyor. Rusya Dışişleri Bakanlığı, 21 Kasım'da ülkeye girdikten sonra çoklu girişli vizesini almak için beş gün beklediğini iddia ederek göç yasalarını ihlal ettiğini söylüyor ve onun kalışını 'yasadışı' olarak nitelendiriyor. Moskova mahkemesi 29 Kasım'da ona ceza verdi ve ülkeden ayrılmasını emretti; Satter 4 Aralık'ta ayrıldı ve şimdi beş yıllık giriş yasağı ile karşı karşıya. Satter, bu iddiaları tamamen reddediyor ve ihraç nedeninin, özellikle Volgograd'taki terör saldırılarından sonra Sochi'nin, yakında düzenlenen Kış Olimpiyatları konumu olarak, aslında bir 'savaş bölgesi' olduğunu söylemesiyle Putin rejimine uzun süredir yönelttiği eleştiriler olduğunu söylüyor. Satter, kendisine uygulanan dili Sovyet dönemi represyonlarıyla karşılaştırıyor ve bu hamlenin bir gazeteciye yönelik olarak henüz görülmemiş olduğunu belirtiyor. Rusya, bu tür yasaklamaların yaygın olduğunu iddia ederek, 500.000'den fazla yabancı vatandaşın kuralları ihlal etmekten dolayı yasaklandığını söylüyor; ancak gözlemciler bunun eleştirel haberleşmeyi susturmak için bilinçli bir sinyal olduğunu düşünüyor. Satter, kararın tersine çevrilmesini umuyor ama şansların düşük olduğunu kabul ediyor. O, bu olayın tüm yabancı muhabirlere şu mesajı verdiğini uyarıyor: Rusya'da dürüst bir haber yapmak artık çok ağır bir maliyet taşıyor.

article_content: BANGKOK, Thailand (CNN) — Thailand’s King Bhumibol Adulyadej, the world’s longest-reigning monarch, has been hospitalized due to fever and fatigue, the Royal Palace announced on Sunday. The 81-year-old king was admitted to a Bangkok hospital on Saturday night. According to a statement from the Royal Household Bureau, doctors are closely monitoring his condition and have begun treatment with antibiotics and intravenous fluids. The statement was widely reported by Thai state media. King Bhumibol was formally crowned on May 5, 1950. Though Thailand transitioned away from absolute monarchy in the 1930s, the king retains immense moral authority and deep public reverence. Last month, he publicly called for national unity amid the country’s prolonged political crisis. Prime Minister Abhisit Vejjajiva confirmed on Sunday that the king sought medical care on his doctors’ advice. 'There is no problem with His Majesty’s condition,' Abhisit told reporters after visiting the hospital. 'Based on my conversations with the medical team, there is nothing to be concerned about,' he added, according to Reuters.
translated_content: BANGKOK, Tayland (CNN) — Dünyanın en uzun süredir tahtta kalan kralı olan Tayland Kralı Bhumibol Adulyadej, ateş ve yorgunluk nedeniyle hastaneye yatırıldı. Kraliyet Sarayı Pazar günü açıkladı. 81 yaşındaki kral, Cumartesi gecesi Bangkok'taki bir hastaneye yatırıldı. Kraliyet Sarayı Bürosu'ndan yapılan açıklamaya göre, doktorlar durumunu yakından takip ediyor ve krala antibiyotik ile intravenöz sıvı tedavisi uygulanıyor. Açıklama, Tayland Ulusal Haber Ajansı ve diğer yerel medya tarafından yayınlandı. Kral Bhumibol, 5 Mayıs 1950'de resmi olarak tahta geçti. Tayland, 1930'larda mutlak monarşi sistemini bıraktı ancak kral hâlâ büyük ahlaki otoriteye ve halktan derin sevgiye sahip. Geçen ay, ülkenin dört yıldır süren siyasi krizinde ulusal birlik çağrısında bulundu. Başbakan Abhisit Vejjajiva, Pazar günü kralın doktorlarının önerisiyle hastaneye gittiğini doğruladı. 'Hükümdarın durumuyla ilgili hiçbir sorun yok,' Abhisit, hastaneye gidip ziyaretçi defterini imzaladıktan sonra gazetecilere söyledi. 'Doktorlarla yaptığım görüşmeler doğrultusunda endişe edilecek bir şey yok,' dedi. (Reuters)

article_content: Dallas (CNN) — Wildfires that have raged across parts of Texas have claimed the lives of a second firefighter. Elias Jaquez, 49, died Wednesday, 11 days after becoming trapped in a blaze and suffering severe burns, Cactus City Manager Steve Schmidt-Witcher said Thursday. 'We're a very small, tight-knit community. Everybody knew Elias and his family,' Schmidt-Witcher said. 'It's having a definite impact.' Firefighter Greg Simmons died last Friday while battling the East Sidewynicks fire in Eastland County. Numerous firefighters have been injured, some seriously. Thousands of firefighters have been battling blazes that have scorched more than a million acres in Texas since April 6. Dry, windy conditions persisted in parts of the state on Thursday, though cooler temperatures and rain in some areas provided relief. 'We've been given a break in the weather,' said April Saginor, spokeswoman for the Texas Forest Service. 'Humidity is up, and temperatures are down.' CNN meteorologist Sean Morris warned that thunderstorms are expected this weekend but will bring little rain — and lightning could ignite new fires. West Texas averages nearly 15 inches of rain annually, according to David Hennig, a meteorologist in Midland, Texas. Over the past six months, just 0.13 inches have been recorded — far below normal levels. While October through March is typically the dry season, this level of precipitation is exceptionally low, Hennig said. Palo Pinto County Sheriff Ira Mercer predicted the fires will long be remembered. 'This is an event that's going to mark time in our county's history,' he said. 'It's something that's going to change forever the landscape and the community itself. It will be life before the fire and life after the fire — it's that big a deal.' On Thursday, Gov. Rick Perry declared Friday through Sunday as Days of Prayer for Rain, urging 'Texans of all faiths and religious traditions' to pray for an end to the ongoing drought and devastating wildfires, as well as the safety of firefighters, according to a statement from his office. The tinder-dry landscape has provided ample fuel: On Thursday, the Texas Forest Service responded to seven new fires covering 159 acres; Wednesday's four fires burned over 1,000 acres; Tuesday's 10 fires totaled more than 2,000 acres. Since January 1, the agency has responded to more than 800 fires that have damaged approximately 5,000 structures across 1.4 million acres. Fires have occurred in 252 of Texas’s 254 counties since December 21, 2010. In addition to in-state crews, the Texas Forest Service is coordinating more than 1,900 firefighters from 36 states — not including volunteer responders. Schmidt-Witcher, who has lived in Moore County for 16 years, said he has never seen fires this severe. Jaquez was among personnel fighting a brush fire south of Dumas on April 9 when two fire trucks became stuck. The four firefighters abandoned their vehicles and attempted to flee. Three suffered smoke inhalation; Jaquez was unable to escape and sustained critical burns. He was transported to a burn unit in Lubbock, Texas, but died Wednesday, leaving behind his wife and four daughters. Flags were flown at half-staff, Schmidt-Witcher said. CNN Radio's Thomas Andres and CNN's Dave Alsup contributed to this report.

article_content: In a sporting world where the biggest clubs typically claim all the glory, the FA Cup offers rare moments when the underdog defeats the giant — not often, but frequently enough to keep hope alive. The English FA Cup is soccer’s oldest knockout competition, and while it is often won by Premier League giants, it has also produced some of the most unforgettable upsets in football history. 'When you're a football club, you dream of playing at Wembley,' said Roberto Martinez after his Wigan Athletic side stunned Manchester City 1-0 in the 2013 final. 'Today, we saw the underdogs play with incredible bravery and belief — they defied the odds again. That’s the FA Cup.' Wigan, competing in their first FA Cup final and having spent less than a decade in the top flight, faced a Manchester City side backed by Abu Dhabi wealth, reigning Premier League champions, and recent FA Cup winners. City’s squad cost over £200 million — eleven individual players exceeded Wigan’s entire transfer budget of £11 million. Dave Whelan, Wigan’s 76-year-old owner, once played in the 1960 FA Cup final for Blackburn, where a broken leg ended his top-level career. He later built a fortune in retail and sportswear, founding JJB Sports, then invested everything into Wigan — funding its stadium and rugby team. His initials now adorn the ground. Whelan led Wigan onto the pitch as their captain, marking a full-circle moment after decades of struggle. Ben Watson scored the winning goal in the 92nd minute, sealing a historic 1-0 win. Though Wigan secured European qualification, their Premier League survival hung by a thread — sitting in the relegation zone with just two games remaining. Martinez, linked with Everton after David Moyes’ departure to Manchester United, remains beloved by Whelan despite near-constant relegation battles. Meanwhile, Roberto Mancini, City’s manager, faced mounting pressure after a trophyless season. He had sold Mario Balotelli and failed to advance from the Champions League group stage. Speculation swirled that Manuel Pellegrini — recently dismissed by Malaga due to financial constraints — would replace Mancini. Pellegrini confirmed his exit, citing UEFA’s financial fair play penalties. On the same day, Frank Lampard became Chelsea’s all-time top scorer with two goals in a 2-1 win over Aston Villa, surpassing Bobby Tambling’s 202-goal record. He reached 203 goals despite no new contract offer. Paul Scholes, aged 38, announced his second retirement. After returning from a 2011 retirement, he will make his 498th Premier League appearance in his final home match for Manchester United — set to receive his 11th league medal under Sir Alex Ferguson.

İngiliz FA Kupası, futbolun en eski elemeli turnuvasıdır ve genellikle Premier Lig devlerinin kazandığı bu turnuvada, futbol tarihinin en unutulmaz şok sonuçlarından bazıları doğmuştur. 'Bir futbol kulübü olarak, Wembley'de oynamayı hayal edersiniz,' 2013 finalinde Manchester City'yi 1-0 mağlup eden Wigan Athletic'in teknik direktörü Roberto Martinez şöyle dedi: 'Bugün, alt sınıftan gelen takımın inanılmaz cesaretle ve inançla oynadığını gördük — tekrar ihtimalleri yendiler. İşte FA Kupası böyle olur.' Wigan, ilk FA Kupası finaline çıkıyor ve üst ligde sadece on yıldan az bir süredir bulunuyordu; karşılarında ise Abu Dabi zenginliğiyle desteklenen, geçen yılın Premier Lig şampiyonu ve bir önceki yılın FA Kupası galibi Manchester City vardı. City'nin kadrosu 200 milyon sterlinin üzerindeydi — on bir bireysel oyuncunun maliyeti, Wigan'ın toplam transfer bütçesi olan 11 milyon sterlini aşıyordu. Wigan'ın 76 yaşındaki sahibi Dave Whelan, 1960 FA Kupası finalinde Blackburn için oynamıştı; ancak oyun sırasında ciddi bir bacak kırığı aldı ve bundan sonra üst düzey futbolu bıraktı. Daha sonra perakende ve spor giyim sektöründe zenginlik kazandı, JJB Sports'u kurdu ve ardından Wigan'a tüm varlığını yatırım yaptı — stadyumunu ve rugby takımını finanse etti. Bugün stadyumun adı baş harfleriyle anılıyor. Whelan, on yıllar süren mücadelelerin ardından tam bir dönüşüm anı olarak, Wigan'ı sahaya kapitän olarak çıkarttı. Ben Watson, 92. dakikada attığı golle tarihi 1-0 zaferini sağladı. Wigan, Avrupa kupalarına katılma hakkı kazansa da, Premier Lig'deki hayatta kalma şansı iki maç kalana kadar iplik gibi askıda kaldı — ligde düşme hattının üçüncü yerindeydiler. Martinez, David Moyes'in Manchester United'a gitmesinden sonra Everton'a transfer olma haberleriyle gündeme gelmişti; ancak Whelan, kulübün sürekli düşme mücadelesi vermesine rağmen 39 yaşındaki antrenöre inanmaya devam etti. Bu arada, Roberto Mancini, bir trofe kazanamadan geçen sezon sonrası yoğun basın altında kaldı. 2010 yılında Inter Milan'dan getirdiği Mario Balotelli'yi satmıştı ve Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde grup aşamasını geçemedi. Manuel Pellegrini'nin Mancini'nin yerini alacağı söylentileri dolaşıyordu — Pellegrini, Malaga'dan mali kısıtlamalar nedeniyle ayrılmıştı. Pellegrini, UEFA'nın mali adalet kuralları nedeniyle Avrupa yarışmalarından men edildiklerini belirterek ayrıldığını doğruladı. Aynı gün, Frank Lampard, Aston Villa'ya karşı 2-1 kazanılan maçta iki gol atarak Chelsea'nin tarihinin en çok gol atan oyuncusu oldu ve Bobby Tambling'ın 202 golüne ulaşarak 203 golle rekoru kırdı. Yeni bir sözleşme teklifi almasa da. 38 yaşındaki Paul Scholes, ikinci kez emekli olduğunu duyurdu. 2011'de emekli olmuştu ama Ferguson tarafından geri çağrılmıştı. Ocak'tan beri oynamasa da, Ferguson, onun son ev sahipliği maçı olan Swansea karşısında 498. Premier Lig maçına çıkacağını açıkladı — ve 11. Premier Lig madalyasını almayı hak ediyor.

article_content: There will be a new women's champion crowned at the French Open this weekend — but at least one of the semifinalists has previously reached the Roland Garros final. Sam Stosur lost her first Grand Slam final in 2010 to Francesca Schiavone and also reached the semifinals the year before. If the Australian can continue her progress in Paris, she could add a second major title to her 2011 US Open victory. Standing in her way is Sara Errani, Schiavone’s compatriot, who aims to secure Italy’s third consecutive final appearance at Roland Garros. The 21st seed has never beaten world No. 6 Stosur in their five previous meetings, having won just one set. However, the 25-year-old has claimed three clay-court titles this year. She reached the quarterfinals of the Australian Open in January, when Stosur, burdened by home expectations after her New York triumph, exited in the first round. Stosur secured her semifinal spot on Tuesday with a dominant 6-4, 6-1 win over Slovakian 15th seed Dominika Cibulkova, who had stunned world No. 1 Victoria Azarenka in the fourth round. Errani followed up her victories over former French Open champions Ana Ivanovic and Svetlana Kuznetsova by defeating German 10th seed Angelique Kerber 6-3, 7-6(7-2), earning her first win over a top-10 player in 29 attempts. 'I don’t have the power of the bigger players, so I rely on speed, endurance, and strategy — it can be tough when my opponent is stronger,' Errani said after her breakthrough win. 'I trained hard all winter, and switching my racket has made me feel more confident on court.' Stosur, one of the tour’s most powerful players, was pleased to overcome the petite Cibulkova, who stands just 5 feet 3 inches tall. 'It’s never easy playing here with the wind and facing an opponent who’s fighting for every point. She moves incredibly fast,' said the 28-year-old, who hopes to become the first Australian woman to win the tournament since Margaret Court in 1973. 'The last few years have been great for me in Paris. This is as good as it gets.' The other two quarterfinals will be played on Wednesday, with world No. 2 Maria Sharapova facing Estonia’s Kaia Kanepi and Czech fourth seed Petra Kvitova taking on Kazakh qualifier Yaroslava Shvedova. Sharapova is aiming to complete her career Grand Slam and could surpass Azarenka to reclaim the world No. 1 ranking with a final appearance.

Turnuvanın en güçlü oyuncularından biri olan Stosur, 5 feet 3 inch (160 cm) boyundaki küçük Cibulkova'yı yendikten memnun kaldı. 'Rüzgarlı koşullarda ve her topu mücadeleye dönüştüren bir rakiple oynamak asla kolay değil. O çok hızlı koşuyor,' dedi 28 yaşındaki Avustralyalı, 1973'te Margaret Court'dan beri Fransa Açık'ta bir Avustralyalı kadının şampiyon olmamasını sona erdirmeyi umuyor. 'Paris'te son birkaç yıl bana çok iyi oldu. Bunu aşan bir şey yok.' Diğer iki çeyrek final maçı Çarşamba günü oynanacak: Dünya 2. sıradaki Maria Sharapova, Estonyalı Kaia Kanepi ile; Çek 4. sıra oyuncusu Petra Kvitova ise Kazak kualifikatör Yaroslava Shvedova ile mücadele edecek. Dünya 2. sıradaki Sharapova, kariyerindeki tüm Grand Slam şampiyonluklarını tamamlamayı hedefliyor ve finalde yer alırsa Azarenka'nın yerini alarak dünya 1. sıraya geri dönebilir.

article_content: Five years after Hurricane Michael devastated the Florida Panhandle, Bonny Paulson’s home in Mexico Beach stood untouched while nearly every neighbor’s house was reduced to rubble. Even though her home sits 14 feet above ground on sturdy pillars, it was the unique rounded design—reminiscent of a ship—that helped it endure Category 5 winds. 'I wasn’t nervous at all,' Paulson recalled, despite evacuation warnings. Post-storm photos showed her house intact, missing only a few shingles. Today, builders like Deltec are designing homes not just to survive storms, but to minimize environmental harm. Their homes feature solar panels mounted flush to the roof so wind can’t lift them, high-efficiency insulation, heat pumps, and energy-saving appliances—all powered by renewable energy. Wetlands and native plants are preserved around developments to absorb floodwaters and lock away carbon. Buildings account for 38% of annual energy-related emissions globally, partly from running lights and AC, but also from manufacturing materials like concrete and steel. Deltec claims only one of nearly 1,400 homes it has built over 30 years has suffered structural damage from hurricane-force winds. Similarly, Pearl Homes’ Hunters Point community in Cortez, Florida, elevates homes 16 feet above code, uses steel roofs that secure solar panels tightly, and includes battery backups. The project is fully LEED Platinum certified. Babcock Ranch, founded by Syd Kitson, calls itself America’s first solar-powered town, generating 150 megawatts from over 680,000 panels spread across 870 acres. Underground wiring, outward-swinging doors, and garage vents prevent pressure buildup during storms. When Hurricane Ian hit in 2022 as a Category 4 storm, Babcock Ranch emerged nearly unscathed. Kitson says the key is working with nature, not against it: they preserved 73,000 acres of wetlands and designed drainage systems based on natural water flow. In the Florida Keys, Natalia Padalino and Alan Klingler are completing their own Deltec home, motivated by fear of rising seas and stronger hurricanes. 'We’re investing in safety and sustainability,' Klingler said. 'And neighbors say if a storm hits, they’ll come to our house.' Paulson adds: 'We’re still building the same fragile homes that get blown away. People aren’t adapting.' The message is clear: the future of housing isn’t just about surviving storms—it’s about healing the planet while you do it.

Evi, zeminden 14 ayak yükseklikteki direkler üzerinde duruyordu, ancak gemiye benzeyen yuvarlak tasarımı, Kategori 5 rüzgarlarını aşıp kurtulmasına yardımcı oldu. 'Hiç endişelenmedim,' Paulson, tahliye uyarısını hatırlarken dedi. Kasırgadan sonra çekilen fotoğraflar, evinin sadece birkaç çatı kaplamasını kaybettiğini gösterdi. Evlerine, rüzgarın altına girmesini engelleyecek şekilde düzgün monte edilmiş güneş panelleri, yüksek verimli izolasyon, ısı pompaları ve enerji tasarrufu sağlayan cihazlar kuruyorlar—tümü yenilenebilir enerjiyle çalışıyor. Gelişim alanları etrafında, sel sularını emen ve karbonu toprakta tutan bataklıklar ve yerli bitkiler korunuyor. Binalar, ışık ve klima gibi ekipmanların çalıştırılmasından kaynaklanan enerjiyle birlikte, beton ve çelik gibi yapı malzemelerinin üretimi nedeniyle yıllık enerjiyle ilişkili sera gazı emisyonlarının %38’ini oluşturuyor. Deltec, son 30 yıl içinde inşa ettiği yaklaşık 1.400 evden yalnızca birinin kasırga rüzgarlarından yapısal hasar gördüğünü iddia ediyor. Benzer şekilde, Florida’nın Cortez kentindeki Pearl Homes’in Hunters Point topluluğu, evleri koddan 16 ayak yukarıya çıkarıyor, güneş panellerini sıkıca sabitleyen çelik çatılar kullanıyor ve pil sistemleriyle güç kesintilerinde yedek enerji sağlıyor. Kitson, anahtarın doğayla savaşmak değil, onunla uyum içinde yaşamak olduğunu söylüyor: 73.000 akre bataklık alanı korundu ve suyun doğal akışını göz önünde bulunduran bir su yönetim sistemi tasarlandı. Florida Anahtarları’nda Natalia Padalino ve eşi Alan Klingler, kendi Deltec evlerini Aralık ayına kadar tamamlamayı planlıyorlar. Çift, küresel ısınma ve kasırgaların Florida Anahtarları’ndaki gelecekteki etkilerinden endişeliydi ve bu tür fırtınalara dayanıklı ve sürdürülebilir evler araştırdılar. 'Güvenli ve sürdürülebilir bir şey inşa ediyoruz,' dedi Klingler. 'Ve komşular, bir kasırga geldiğinde bizim evimize gelmeyeceklerini söylüyorlar.' Paulson şöyle ekliyor: 'Hâlâ patlayan evleri inşa ediyoruz. İnsanlar adapte olmuyor.' Mesaj açık: evlerin geleceği sadece kasırgalardan kurtulmak değil, bunu yaparken gezegeni iyileştirmek.

article_content: In Western Australia, Rawinia Hayes, owner of Amazing 4D Imaging, has pleaded not guilty to 18 criminal charges related to selling counterfeit ultrasound images to expecting mothers. According to reports from the ABC and local media, nearly 80 women filed complaints after discovering that the photos they received—purportedly of their unborn children—were actually downloaded from the internet. Some mothers only realized the deception years later, when they stumbled upon the exact same images online, often appearing in the albums of other women with different due dates. One mother, Charlotte Shilcof from Bunbury, shared how she proudly kept the fake photos in a scrapbook, believing them to be precious memories of her daughter Ava’s development. When she finally recognized the images as duplicates, she described feeling deeply hurt—not just because the photos were false, but because they represented a time she thought was uniquely hers. Other women reported similar experiences: one found all eight images she received were of different babies; another realized her twin sons’ ‘ultrasound’ matched a photo already circulating online. For some, the betrayal went further—one partner had planned to tattoo the image on his chest before learning it wasn’t his child’s face. The scandal came to light after a local woman posted her suspicions on Facebook, sparking a wave of responses. Over 100 affected mothers joined a support group, comparing photos and sharing stories of devastation. Consumer Protection confirmed receiving 76 formal written complaints, calling the case unprecedented. Though Hayes claims her business was legitimate and is reportedly considering legal action against those making defamatory statements, victims remain unconvinced. Many are still discovering the truth months or even years after the fact, particularly among those who lost babies during pregnancy. Hayes is scheduled to return to court on April 9, where she will face charges including fraudulent representation and failure to deliver services paid for.

ABC ve yerel medyaya göre, neredeyse 80 kadın, kendilerine bebeğinin gerçek ultrason görüntüsü olarak sunulan fotoğrafların aslında internetten indirilmiş olduğunu keşfettikten sonra şikayette bulundu. Bazı anneler, bu sahte görüntülerin tamamen aynı şekilde başka hamile kadınların albümlerinde de göründüğünü yıllar sonra fark etti. Bunbury'lı bir anne olan Charlotte Shilcof, kızı Ava'nın gelişimini temsil ettiğini düşünerek sahte fotoğrafları bir kesele dikkatlice sakladığını paylaştı. Görsellerin kopyalar olduğunu fark ettiğinde, sadece fotoğrafların sahte olduğundan değil, kendi özel bir anını temsil ettiğini düşündüğü bir zamanın yanıltıldığını söyleyerek derin bir üzüntü yaşadığını ifade etti. Diğer anneler de benzer deneyimler yaşadı: biri aldığı sekiz fotoğrafın tümünün farklı bebeklere ait olduğunu gördü; diğer biri ikiz oğullarının 'ultrason' görüntüsünün zaten internette dolaşan bir resimle aynı olduğunu fark etti. Bazı durumlarda, bu ihanet daha da derindi—bir eşim, çocuğunun yüzü olmadığını öğrendiğinde göğsüne dövme yapma planını iptal etti. Skandal, yerel bir kadının Facebook'ta şüphelerini paylaşmasıyla ortaya çıktı ve bu, birçok yanıt yarattı. 100'den fazla etkilenen anne, fotoğrafları karşılaştırarak ve kendi hikayelerini paylaşarak bir destek grubu oluşturdu. Tüketici Koruma, 76 adet resmi yazılı şikayet aldığını doğruladı ve bu davayı tarihte görülmemiş bir durum olarak nitelendirdi. Hayes, işinin meşru ve profesyonel olduğunu iddia ediyor ve hakaret içerikli iddialara karşı yasal adım atmayı düşünüyor gibi görünüyor; ancak mağdurlar ikna olmuyor. Özellikle gebe kalma sürecinde bebeklerini kaybeden kadınlar arasında, hâlâ bazıları bu gerçekle yüzleşiyor. Hayes, 9 Nisan'da dolandırıcılık ve ödenen hizmetlerin sağlanmaması suçlamalarıyla yeniden mahkemede yer alacak.

article_content: (CNN) — Rafael Nadal and Roger Federer continued their preparations for the first Grand Slam of the season with contrasting victories on Friday at tournaments in Doha and Brisbane. World No. 1 Nadal has never won the Qatar Open and is now one match away from achieving that goal. However, he was pushed to three sets by German qualifier Peter Gojowczyk, who had enjoyed a breakthrough run to his first ATP Tour semifinal. Earlier, Federer dropped just two games on the Gold Coast, defeating Marinko Matosevic 6-1, 6-1 in just 58 minutes to reach the semifinals. Nadal, the only remaining seed after shock exits by Andy Murray and David Ferrer, dropped the opening set to Gojowczyk but fought back to win 4-6, 6-2, 6-3 in just under two hours. "The positive thing is I’m in the final in the first week of the season without having had much preparation," Nadal told the official ATP Tour website. "Even without playing my best, I found a way. It’s true I played better toward the end than I did at the start." Nadal is likely to face a tough challenge in Saturday’s final at the Khalifa Tennis Complex, where he will meet France’s Gaël Monfils. A Doha specialist and two-time finalist there, Monfils demonstrated his form with a straight-sets 6-3, 6-2 win over Germany’s Florian Mayer in under an hour. He has defeated Nadal twice in Doha and looked sharp against Mayer. Federer, playing in Brisbane for the first time in his career, delivered a masterclass against his Australian opponent. He was briefly tested in the opening game, facing three break points, before taking firm control. The top seed will next face France’s Jeremy Chardy, who defeated wildcard Sam Groth 7-5, 6-4. The other semifinal will feature second seed Kei Nishikori of Japan and home favorite Lleyton Hewitt. Nishikori edged out Croatia’s Marin Čilić in three sets, while Hewitt continued his strong run with a 6-4, 6-2 straight-sets victory over Romanian qualifier Marius Copil.

Dünya 1. sırasındaki Nadal, Katar Açık'ta hiç şampiyon olmamıştır ve bu hedefe ulaşmak için yalnızca bir maç daha kaldı. Ancak, ilk ATP tur yarı finaline ulaşan Alman kwalifikatör Peter Gojowczyk tarafından üç sete zorlandı. article_content: Authorities are investigating a letter bomb addressed to the CEO of Deutsche Bank that was delivered to the bank's headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany, police said Wednesday. The device, which contained shrapnel, was detected in the bank's mail room around 1 p.m. local time, said Paul Browne, deputy commissioner of the New York Police Department. It did not detonate. 'The return address was listed as the European Central Bank, which would likely increase the chances of it being opened,' said Browne, urging increased mailroom security nationwide. 'A suspicious letter was received today at Deutsche Bank, addressed to Dr. Josef Ackermann,' said bank spokesman Ronald Weichert. 'In-house departments promptly alerted the police,' who then launched an investigation. The incident prompted New York authorities to increase security around Deutsche Bank’s Manhattan offices. CNN's Susan Candiotti and Diana Magnay contributed to this report.

Şarjlı parçacıklar içeren cihaz, yerel saatle 13:00 civarında bankanın posta odasında tespit edildi, dedi New York Polis Dairesi Başkomiser Yardımcısı Paul Browne. Cihaz patlamadı. 'Geri gönderen adres, Avrupa Merkez Bankası olarak listelenmişti, bu da açılma ihtimalini artırabilir,' dedi Browne ve posta güvenliğini artırmayı önerdi. 'Bugün Deutsche Bank'a Dr. Josef Ackermann'e gönderilen şüpheli bir mektup alındı,' dedi banka sözcüsü Ronald Weichert. 'İç birimler hemen polisi bilgilendirdi,' ki bu da soruşturma başlatılmasına neden oldu. Olay, New York yetkililerinin Manhattan'daki Deutsche Bank ofisleri etrafındaki güvenlik önlemlerini güçlendirmesine neden oldu. CNN'nin Susan Candiotti ve Diana Magnay bu habere katkıda bulundu.

article_content: A 14-year-old schoolgirl remains on life support after being gang-raped in Mandhala Channa village, Jalandhar district, Punjab, on January 28, 2013. Ten days later, no arrests have been made. Punjab Congress president Capt Amarinder Singh condemned the attack and criticized the state’s handling of sexual violence, calling it a symptom of systemic failure. According to Singh, an average of 40 rapes occur monthly in Punjab, and he pointed to the pardon of 12 convicted rapists in 2012 as evidence of the government’s dismissive attitude toward the crime. Singh directly challenged Deputy Chief Minister Sukhbir Badal’s claim that Punjab is the 'safest state in the country,' stating, 'This for sure cannot be described as the safest state in the country as this government will try to make us believe.' The victim was transferred to a hospital in Amritsar, where doctors report she is stable but refuse to provide further updates until after 24 hours. Singh emphasized that the government must not absolve itself of responsibility by merely covering medical costs — accountability is required.

On gün sonra henüz hiçbir tutuklama yapılmadı. Punjab Kongresi başkanı Capt Amarinder Singh, saldırıyı kınadı ve cinsel şiddetin idaresini sistemik bir başarısızlık olarak nitelendirdi. Singh'e göre, Punjab'da aylık ortalama 40 tecavüz olayı yaşanıyor ve 2012 yılında 12 mahkûm tecavüzcünün affedilmesi, hükümetin bu suçla ilgili dikkatsiz tutumunun kanıtıdır. Singh, Punjab'ın 'ülkenin en güvenli eyaleti' olduğunu iddia eden Başbakan Yardımcısı Sukhbir Badal'ı doğrudan sorguladı ve şöyle dedi: 'Bu kesinlikle hükümetin bize inandırmaya çalıştığı gibi ülkenin en güvenli eyaleti olarak tanımlanamaz.' Singh, hükümetin sadece tedavi maliyetini karşılamakla sorumluluğundan kaçamayacağını vurguladı — hesap verebilirlik gerekli.

article_content: Three days ago, 15-year-old Jessica Buttigieg disappeared after stepping off her school bus in the village of Locking, near Weston-super-Mare. Since then, her parents, Jonathan and Jayne, have made a heartfelt plea for her to reach out — any way she can — just to let them know she’s safe. They’re not asking for explanations, only reassurance. Jessica was last seen around 3:30 p.m., near the Post Office and Manor Stores, dressed in grey trousers, a maroon sweatshirt, and a black hoodie. Authorities say there have been unconfirmed reports of her being spotted later that evening at Tesco and McDonald’s in town, but nothing has been verified. Avon and Somerset Police are working closely with her school and friends, and while they stress she’s not in any trouble, they’re growing increasingly worried given her age. Detective Sergeant Phil Clarke urged anyone with information to come forward, and appealed directly to Jessica: 'We just want to make sure you’re okay.' Her family added, 'If you don’t feel ready to talk to us, please call Grandma or Nanny. We love you, and we just need to know you’re safe.'

article_content: Last winter, the Chicago Crime Commission and the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration named Mexican drug lord Joaquín 'El Chapo' Guzmán Loera Chicago's 'Public Enemy No. 1.' Known by his nickname 'Shorty,' Guzmán leads the Sinaloa cartel — the world’s largest narcotics trafficking organization — which is accused of smuggling 1,500 to 2,000 kilograms of cocaine into Chicago each month. Arthur Bilek, executive vice president of the Chicago Crime Commission, stated that due to the direct connection between street gang violence and the narcotics trade, 'Guzmán’s fingerprints are on the guns used in many of the shootings plaguing Chicago today.' Though there is no confirmed record of Guzmán ever visiting Chicago, The New York Times Magazine reported that he refers to the city as his cartel’s 'home port.' Jack Riley, head of the DEA’s Chicago office, affirmed that the scale of destruction caused by the Sinaloa cartel warrants the title. The last time Chicago officially designated a 'Public Enemy No. 1' was in 1930, when Al Capone — the notorious mob boss who used the city as the center of his criminal empire — was named to the position. Capone’s reign was marked by brutal violence, yet he was ultimately imprisoned not for murder or racketeering, but for income tax evasion. Crimes have evolved — but the legal tools to hold powerful criminals accountable often lag behind. Today, suspected drug lords like Guzmán and Zeta cartel leader Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo face similar challenges in prosecution, despite their vast networks of violence and corruption.

'Kısa' lakabıyla bilinen Guzmán, dünyanın en büyük uyuşturucu kaçakçılığı örgütü olan Sinaloa Kartelini yönetiyor ve her ay 1.500 ila 2.000 kilogram kokaini Şikago'ya soktuğu iddia ediliyor. Şikago Suç Komisyonu yürütücü başkanı Arthur Bilek, sokak çetelerinin şiddetleri ile uyuşturucu ticareti arasındaki doğrudan bağlantıyı vurgulayarak, 'Guzmán'ın parmak izi, Şikago'yu saran birçok ateşli olayda kullanılan silahlarda bulunuyor,' dedi. Guzmán'ın Şikago'ya hiç gitmediğine dair kesin bir kayıt olmasa da, The New York Times Dergisi, onun şehri kartelinin 'ana limanı' olarak tanımladığını rapor etti. DEA'nın Şikago şubesinin başı Jack Riley, Sinaloa Kartelinin neden olduğu yıkım ölçeğinin bu unvanı hak ettiğini doğruladı. Şikago'nun son kez 'En Büyük Düşmanı No. 1' ilan ettiği zaman 1930 idi; o dönemde Al Capone — suçlu faaliyetlerinin merkezi olarak şehri kullanan ünlü bir mob boss — bu unvana layık görüldü. Capone'un hâkimiyeti brutal şiddetlerle karakterize edilmişti, ancak sonunda cinayet veya riketirme gibi suçlarla değil, gelir vergisi kaçakçılığı nedeniyle hapse atıldı. Suçlar değişti — ancak güçlü suçluları cezalandırma araçları genellikle geride kaldı. Bugün, Guzmán ve Zeta Karteli lideri Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo gibi şüpheli uyuşturucu lordları, geniş şiddet ve yolsuzluk ağlarına rağmen benzer mahkeme zorluklarıyla karşı karşıyalar.

The incident occurred above Yelahanka Air Force Station in Bangalore, home to this year’s Aero India event, which drew approximately 450,000 attendees. The Flying Bulls, who previously performed at Aero India in 2011 and 2013, are unlikely to return to this year’s show.

article_content: Arlington, Virginia (CNN) — Alan Tolbert isn’t your typical 13-year-old. While many kids his age were shopping at the mall or playing football, Tolbert traveled from Shippensburg, Pennsylvania, to Arlington National Cemetery dressed in a navy blue Civil War reenactment uniform, carrying a brass bugle. Around him stood nearly 200 fellow buglers and trumpeters from across the United States — some traveling from as far as California — all gathered to mark the 150th anniversary of 'Taps,' the iconic military melody. Though slightly smaller than his peers, Tolbert’s uniform was too large — so much so that his mother rolled up the pant legs three times to make them fit. But he didn’t mind. His only focus was mastering the 24 haunting notes of 'Taps.' Born during the Civil War along the James River in 1862, 'Taps' was composed by Union General Daniel Butterfield, who sought a more solemn alternative to the standard bugle call signaling lights out. Today, it is played roughly 30 times a day at Arlington, most notably at the Tomb of the Unknowns. To honor this milestone, Buglers Across America — a nonprofit dedicated to providing live bugle renditions at veteran funerals instead of recordings — assembled nearly 200 volunteers for a unified performance. After playing together, each musician sought out an individual gravesite to perform 'Taps' in solitude. Some chose graves based on proximity. Others, like Tolbert, picked ones steeped in history. He selected the final resting place of Johnny Clem, a 10-year-old drummer who rose to sergeant by age 12 during the Civil War. While Tolbert usually plays alone, he called the experience extraordinary — performing alongside some of the nation’s finest buglers on hallowed ground. Still, he doesn’t plan to join the military. 'I don’t think I want to be in the military one day,' he said. 'So the best I can do to serve our country is to honor those who are.' For many veterans and active-duty personnel, playing 'Taps' at Arlington is the highest honor. Jari Villanueva, a 23-year military veteran and renowned bugle historian, described it as his way of giving back. 'It’s our way of saying, 'Thank you. Safely rest. God is nigh,'' he said, quoting the melody’s traditional closing words. Allison Cummings, a patrol officer from Hudson, New Hampshire, typically plays 'Taps' at law enforcement funerals back home. But performing at Arlington felt different. 'I started playing trumpet in fifth grade. I remember visiting here even then,' she said, standing beside her chosen grave, a gold commemorative coin ready to be placed on the white marble headstone. 'This is like Carnegie Hall for me. It’s the ultimate privilege — a final thank you to someone who gave everything.'

Birlikte çaldıktan sonra, her müzisyen bir mezar taşını seçip yalnızca o mezar için 'Taps' çaldı. Bazıları sadece konumuna göre seçim yaptı. Diğerleri ise tarihi öneme sahip olanları seçti. Tolbert, 10 yaşında davulcu olarak gönüllü olmuş, 12 yaşında albay rütbesine ulaşan Sivil Savaş dönemi Johnny Clem’in mezarını seçti. Tolbert genellikle yalnızca çalar, ancak bu deneyimi olağanüstü buldu — ulusal düzeydeki en iyi trompetçilerle, mezarlığın kutsal zemininde çalmak. Yine de, askeri kariyer planlamıyor. 'Askeri kariyer yapmak istemiyorum,' dedi. 'Bu yüzden ülkeye hizmet edebildiğim en iyi yol, onları onurlandırmak.' Çoğu askeri veterana göre, Arlington’da 'Taps' çalmak en büyük onur. 23 yıllık askeri hizmet vermiş ve ünlü trompet tarihçisi Jari Villanueva, bunu Amerika için savaşanlara teşekkür etmenin bir yolu olarak tanımladı. 'Bu, askere 'Teşekkür ederiz. Güvenle dinlenin. Tanrı yakındır,' demek için bizim yolumuz,' dedi ve melodinin geleneksel kapanış sözlerini aktardı. New Hampshire’dan Hudson’lı bir polis memuru olan Allison Cummings, genellikle ev eyaletindeki polis cenaze törenlerinde 'Taps' çalar. Ama Arlington’da çalmak farklıydı. 'Beşinci sınıftan beri trampet çalıyorum. O zamandan beri burayı ziyaret etmeyi hatırlıyorum,' dedi ve seçtiği mezarın yanında, performansından sonra beyaz mermer başlığa bırakmak üzere altın bir anı madalyonunu elinde tuttu. 'Bu benim için Carnegie Hall gibi. Bu, her şeyi veren birine son teşekkür vermektir.'

article_content: CNN — Johan Bruyneel has become the first major figure to step down following a U.S. government investigation into Lance Armstrong and systemic doping in professional cycling. The U.S. Anti-Doping Agency (USADA) stated Wednesday that Armstrong was part of 'the most sophisticated, professionalized, and successful doping program that sport has ever seen,' releasing over 1,000 pages of supporting evidence. Bruyneel, who served as Armstrong’s team manager during his seven Tour de France victories from 1999 to 2005, has stepped down as general manager of RadioShack Nissan Trek by mutual agreement. According to the USADA report, Bruyneel played a key role in coordinating doping activities within the U.S. Postal Service team. A statement on the team’s website read: 'Effective immediately, Johan Bruyneel will no longer serve as general manager of the RadioShack Nissan Trek cycling team.' Bruyneel expressed disappointment with how the investigation has been handled, arguing that USADA’s public release of evidence prior to his opportunity to respond violated fundamental legal principles. 'I am surprised and extremely disappointed that USADA released information in the public domain relating to their pending case against me before I had been given any opportunity to review the evidence or provide my defense,' he told AFP. 'I still hope to defend myself in a fair forum, but I now fear USADA’s actions may have irreversibly prejudiced my case.' He added: 'It is troubling that USADA appears not to respect basic rights such as the presumption of innocence and the right to be heard.' Bruyneel also worked with Armstrong during his brief return to cycling in 2009 and 2010. Alongside team doctor Pedro Celaya and trainer Jose 'Pepe' Marti, Bruyneel is scheduled to appear before an independent arbitrator to contest the charges. Bruyneel’s departure follows comments from RadioShack rider Fabian Cancellara, who said he was considering leaving the team after seeing the report. 'Johan’s name is cited 129 times in the document,' Cancellara told Belgium’s Het Laatste Nieuws. 'I don’t know if I can continue working with him. We’ll see what happens next. I need to know the truth.'

article_content: Manchester City striker Álvaro Negredo has shared a photo on social media of himself traveling to Sevilla on holiday after being left out of Spain’s final 23-man squad for the 2014 FIFA World Cup. The image shows Negredo, 28, in a car with his wife, Clara García Tapia, former Sevilla teammate Javi Varas, and another companion, following his omission from Spain’s friendly against Bolivia. His tweet read: 'Back to Sevilla with my wife @ClaraGarciaT and my friend @Eu_29 (Javi Varas). Let’s start our holiday!' Meanwhile, Spain defeated Bolivia 2-0 in a friendly on June 1, 2014, with Fernando Torres scoring from the penalty spot in the 51st minute and Andrés Iniesta adding a second in the 84th. However, Torres also produced a shocking miss earlier in the match — with only the goalkeeper to beat, he attempted a delicate chip that sailed high and wide, prompting widespread commentary. Despite the miss, Torres was named in Spain’s World Cup squad, alongside Manchester City’s David Silva. Fellow City player Jesús Navas was omitted. Diego Costa, who had recovered from a hamstring injury, earned his place alongside David Villa. Barcelona stars Xavi, Iniesta, and Cesc Fabregas, along with Juan Mata, were also selected. Spain’s full squad includes goalkeepers Iker Casillas, Pepe Reina, and David de Gea; defenders Sergio Ramos, Gerard Piqué, Raúl Albiol, César Azpilicueta, Juanfran, and Jordi Alba; midfielders Xabi Alonso, Sergio Busquets, Santi Cazorla, Koke, and Javi Martínez; and forwards Pedro and David Villa. The match was officiated by referee Lorenc Jemini of Albania, with an attendance of 35,000 at the Estadio Metropolitano in Madrid.

article_content: Former Premier League midfielder Lassana Diarra has issued a forceful denial of rumors claiming he is fighting as a jihadist in Syria. The 29-year-old, who played for Arsenal, Chelsea, and Portsmouth, has never set foot in the war-torn country, according to his lawyer, Eric Dupond-Moretti. Dupond-Moretti stated that Diarra 'denies in the most formal, the most categorical, and the most absolute fashion that he has gone to Syria.' He emphasized that Diarra is a professional footballer currently playing for Lokomotiv Moscow in Russia and is expected to feature in an upcoming league match. The false claims stem from a video posted on an extremist website, featuring a masked man identifying himself as 'Abu Isa al-Andalus.' The individual, holding an AK-47, urges Western Muslims to leave their homes and join ISIS in Syria, invoking religious justifications and criticizing Western society. The video, hosted on FiSyria.com, alleges that the man previously played for Arsenal after growing up alongside a famous footballer, was radicalized in London two years ago, and abandoned his career to pursue jihad. However, Arsenal has officially confirmed they have no record of a player named Abu Isa al-Andalus, and no verifiable evidence links him to Diarra. The situation reflects broader concerns in Europe: hundreds of French and British citizens have traveled to Syria to join extremist groups. French Prime Minister Manuel Valls has warned that returning fighters pose severe security risks. Earlier this year, two teenage French boys were arrested in Turkey while attempting to reach Syria. Security officials, including OSCT Director General Charles Farr, describe the Syrian conflict as the most significant counter-terrorism challenge since 9/11 — citing the scale of foreign fighter mobilization, easy access to weapons, and the proliferation of militant groups.

article_content: FIFA has officially closed its investigation into claims that North Korea retaliated against its national football team after their disappointing World Cup performance, calling the allegations 'baseless.' The global soccer body said it reviewed all available information and found no proof of mistreatment toward head coach Kim Jong Hun or his players. Reports had surfaced after North Korea lost all three group-stage matches — including a crushing 7-0 defeat to Portugal — sparking concerns that athletes and staff faced public shaming or punishment upon returning home. In response, the North Korean Football Federation insisted that everyone remains in good standing, continuing regular training and preparing for the upcoming Asian Games. They also clarified that their federation president was elected through proper internal procedures, not influenced by match outcomes. FIFA emphasized it had verified multiple sources before concluding the matter, effectively ending speculation without sanctions or further action.

article_content: Plastic banknotes are set to be introduced in Britain, replacing paper currency that has been in use for more than 300 years. The Bank of England has launched a £1 billion tender for the printing of polymer notes at its facility in Debden, Essex, starting in 2015. Paper money may be fully phased out within three years, following centuries of dominance. Bidders must be prepared to transition immediately from paper to polymer production at the start of the contract. Since 2003, the contract has been held by De La Rue—one of only two global manufacturers of polymer banknotes. De La Rue recently produced new plastic notes for Fiji, following Australia’s pioneering introduction of polymer currency in 1988 to combat counterfeiting. Polymer notes have proven successful and are especially favored by surfers, who appreciate that money doesn’t disintegrate when wet. Other countries using polymer notes include New Zealand, Romania, Papua New Guinea, Mexico, and Vietnam. In Northern Ireland, a plastic £5 note was introduced in 1999 to commemorate the Millennium. Bank of England Chief Cashier Chris Salmon confirmed the institution is evaluating polymer notes as a replacement for paper. Polymer notes last significantly longer than cotton-fiber paper notes—for example, an Australian $5 bill lasts around 40 months versus just six months for a £5 paper note. They are more hygienic, absorbing fewer bacteria; harder to tear or crease—making them ideal for vending machines; and waterproof, even surviving a wash cycle. A key security feature is a transparent window containing an optical variable device that splits light into colors, making counterfeiting extremely difficult. Polymer notes can also incorporate holograms and are more environmentally friendly because fewer need to be printed and they are recyclable. However, they are considerably more expensive to produce, and widespread adoption would require costly upgrades to ATMs and vending machines. The Bank plans to initially introduce polymer notes in lower denominations—such as the £5—because they circulate more frequently and wear out faster. De La Rue CEO Tim Cobbold noted that banknotes endure heavy use: 'They’re folded, crumpled, carried in wallets, and exposed to wet and dry conditions.' Financial expert David Buik of Cantor Index cautioned against rushing the transition: 'Money laundering is a major issue—if polymer notes can be made more traceable, that would be beneficial—but it must be coordinated internationally.' A Bank of England spokesperson stated: 'No final decisions have been made, but we are considering all options.'

De La Rue, polimer para biriminin 1988'de sahtekârlıkla mücadele amacıyla Avustralya'da tanıtıldığından sonra Fiji için yeni plastik banknotlar üretti. Ana güvenlik özelliği, ışığı renklerine ayıran bir optik değişken cihaz içeren şeffaf bir penceredir ve sahtekârlık yapmak son derece zordur. Polimer banknotlar ayrıca hologramlar içerebilir ve daha az sayıda basılması gerektiği ve geri dönüştürülebilir oldukları için çevreye daha dosttur. Ancak üretim maliyetleri oldukça yüksektir ve yaygın kabul için ATM'ler ve otomatik makinelere yapılan maliyetli güncellemeler gereklidir. Banka, daha sık dolaşan ve daha hızlı aşınan 5 sterlin gibi düşük değerli banknotları ilk olarak tanıtmayı planlıyor. De La Rue CEO'su Tim Cobbold, banknotların ağır kullanımına maruz kaldığını belirtti: 'Katlanıyor, eziliyor, cüzdanlara girip çıkıyor ve nemli ya da kuru koşullarda bulunabiliyor.' Cantor Index'in finansal uzmanı David Buik, geçişi acele etmemeyi tavsiye etti: 'Para aklama büyük bir sorun—eğer polimer banknotlar daha izlenebilir hale getirilebilirse bu çok iyi olur—ancak uluslararası düzeyde koordinasyon gereklidir.' Bank of England'dan bir temsilci şunu söyledi: 'Henüz kesin kararlar alınmadı, ancak tüm seçenekler değerlendiriliyor.'

article_content: The chief prosecutor of the International Criminal Court (ICC), Luis Moreno-Ocampo, has filed genocide charges against Sudan’s President Omar Hassan al-Bashir, accusing him of orchestrating a five-year campaign of violence in Darfur. The U.N. estimates that 300,000 people have died and 2.5 million have been forcibly displaced during the conflict. Moreno-Ocampo presented evidence to a three-judge panel requesting an arrest warrant for al-Bashir, arguing that the president bears criminal responsibility for five counts of genocide, two counts of crimes against humanity, and two counts of war crimes. These charges stem from a brutal counter-insurgency campaign launched after rebels rose up in Darfur in 2003. According to the prosecutor, government forces and allied Janjaweed militias systematically targeted civilians from three African ethnic groups — including the Fur — through mass killings, rape, and forced displacement to eliminate their presence in the region. The ICC has not yet ruled on whether these acts meet the legal definition of genocide; that determination will be made by the court. In an exclusive interview with CNN, Moreno-Ocampo declared, 'After three years, I have strong evidence that al-Bashir is committing genocide. I cannot be blackmailed. Silence never helped the victims — silence helped the perpetrators.' Sudan has rejected the ICC’s authority, noting it is not a party to the Rome Statute. Sudanese Vice President Ali Osman Mohammed Taha dismissed the charges as an attempt to 'paralyze' the country, while Ambassador Abdalmahmood Abdalhaleem Mohamad warned of 'retaliation' — though he clarified Sudan is not mobilizing its military. Instead, the government has organized public demonstrations in support of al-Bashir. At a rally in Khartoum, thousands greeted al-Bashir with chants of 'Death to America' and signs mocking the prosecutor. One official called the charges 'stupid and malicious,' framing them as part of a broader Western conspiracy. Despite the charges, the joint African Union-United Nations peacekeeping mission (UNAMID) remains operational in Darfur, even as the U.N. evacuates non-essential personnel due to worsening security conditions. Two other individuals — former interior minister Ahmad Harun and militia leader Ali Kushayb — have already been indicted by the ICC but remain free in Sudan under al-Bashir’s protection. Moreno-Ocampo stated that without a U.N. Security Council resolution compelling enforcement, al-Bashir is unlikely to be apprehended. The prosecutor emphasized that rape has been used as a weapon of war to dismantle communities: 'They are raping women, raping girls, raping in groups — raping to destroy the communities.' While the U.S. and many international observers classify the atrocities as genocide, Sudan continues to downplay the scale of violence, claiming media reports are exaggerated. The ICC’s ability to deliver justice, however, hinges on political will rather than legal precedent alone.

BM, çatışmalar sırasında 300.000 kişinin öldüğünü ve 2,5 milyon kişinin zorla yerinden edildiğini tahmin ediyor. Savcıya göre, hükümet kuvvetleri ve eşlik eden Janjaweed milisleri, varlığını ortadan kaldırmak amacıyla Fur gibi üç Afrika etnik grubundaki sivilleri kitle halinde öldürerek, tecavüz ederek ve zorla sürgün etmiştir. CNN ile yapılan özel bir röportajda Moreno-Ocampo, 'Üç yıl sonra, el-Başır'ın soykırım yaptığını kanıtlayacak güçlü delillere sahibim. Beni siyasi baskıya uğratamazsınız. Sessizlik mağdurlara asla yardımcı olmamıştır — sessizlik katillerin yardımcısı olmuştur.' dedi. Sudan, İCM'nin yetkisini reddederek Roma Statüsü’nün tarafı olmadığını belirtti. Sudanlı Başkan Yardımcısı Ali Osman Muhammed Taha, suçlamaları ülkeyi 'pasifleştirmeye' yönelik bir girişim olarak niteledi, ve BM Temsilcisi Abdalmahmood Abdalhaleem Mohamad, 'karşı önlem' sözü kullandı ancak Sudan'ın ordusunu harekete geçirmeyeceğini açıkladı. Bunun yerine, hükümet el-Başır'ı desteklemek için kamuoyu gösterileri düzenliyor. Khartoum'da bir mitingde binlerce kişi, 'Ölüm Amerika' sloganları ve savcıyı alay eden tabletlere rağmen el-Başır'ı karşıladı. Bir yetkili, suçlamaları 'aptalca ve kötülük dolu' olarak nitelendirdi ve bunların ülkeye yönelik daha geniş bir batılı kompironun parçası olduğunu savundu. Suçlamalara rağmen, Ortak Afrika Birliği-BM barış gücü (UNAMID), BM'nin gereksiz personeli geri çekmesine rağmen Darfur'da faaliyetlerine devam etmeye devam ediyor. Daha önce İCM tarafından suçlanan iki başka birey — eski içişleri bakanı Ahmed Harun ve milis lideri Ali Kushayb — hâlâ el-Başır'ın koruması altında Sudan'da serbest. Moreno-Ocampo, el-Başır'ın yakalanması için BM Güvenlik Konseyi'nin bir kararname çıkarmaması halinde mümkün olmayacağını söyledi. Savcı, tecavüzün toplulukları yok etmek amacıyla bir savaş silahı olarak kullanıldığını vurguladı: 'Kadınları tecavüz ediyorlar, kızları tecavüz ediyorlar, grup halinde tecavüz ediyorlar — toplulukları yok etmek için tecavüz ediyorlar.' ABD ve birçok uluslararası gözlemci, olayları soykırım olarak sınıflandırırken, Sudan medyanın yansıttığı kadar şiddetin olmadığını iddia ederek olayların abartıldığını savunuyor. Ancak İCM'nin adaleti sağlama kapasitesi, yalnızca yasal önceliklerden ziyade siyasi iradeye bağlıdır.

article_content: CNN — Nineteen-year-old Sergio Peña is living his dream. 'You know, to be a race car driver — it almost doesn’t seem real,' he said. 'It doesn’t feel like a job at all. It’s more like play to me.' Peña may say it feels like play, but his work ethic tells a different story. 'He is a very methodical, highly calculated race car driver,' said Kip Childress, director of NASCAR’s K&N Pro Series East. 'Sergio is a driver who thinks deeply behind the wheel.' Originally from Virginia, Peña is a first-generation Colombian American. His passion for racing began at age four, when his father bought him a dirt bike. Jai Peña knew early on there was no turning back. 'He loved it from day one,' his father said. Peña has competed professionally since he was 13 — in motocross, go-karts, and formula cars. But his pursuit of speed came at a steep cost: Jai Peña funded his son’s dreams for years, estimating total spending above $1 million. 'I wouldn’t change a thing,' he said. 'The economy is tough, but if I had to do it again, I’d do it all over.' NASCAR requires substantial financial backing to compete at a high level — and has historically been criticized for lacking diversity. In response, the sport launched its 'Drive for Diversity' program in 2004 to identify marketable minority and female drivers with grassroots racing experience. Each year, over 200 applicants vie for six to ten spots. 'The main goal of the Drive for Diversity program is to give minorities a chance to enter the sport,' said Sergio Peña. 'It helps them get noticed and move up to higher NASCAR series or bigger teams.' Peña completed the program and earned sponsorship from Hattori Racing Enterprises. With strong team support, his skills sharpened. In 2023, he had a breakout season: he tied for the most wins in the K&N Pro Series East and finished fifth in the championship standings. 'Having great support and opportunity only gets you so far,' Childress noted. 'Success in NASCAR is measured in wins. Sergio has done the work — and he’s delivered on the track.' 'I’m just another kid chasing a dream,' Peña said. 'I’m incredibly grateful to everyone who’s helped me along the way.' On diversifying NASCAR: 'It’s getting there — step by step.'

article_content: At 17, Cassandra Fortin was diagnosed with Hodgkin’s lymphoma — a treatable form of blood cancer — but she’s fighting to avoid chemotherapy, believing it poisons her body. Her mother, Jackie Fortin, stands by her, recalling how Cassandra has held this view since childhood. When doctors at Connecticut Children’s Medical Center urged treatment, Cassandra became so overwhelmed she ran away. Authorities responded by placing her under state custody through the Department of Children and Families (DCF), arguing her refusal endangered her life. A judge granted DCF temporary authority to make medical decisions for her, requiring her to continue treatment. Now, after receiving about three weeks of chemo, Cassandra continues to resist further sessions. Her legal team argues this case isn’t just about one teenager — it’s about whether minors have the constitutional right to control what enters their bodies. With survival rates for teens like Cassandra estimated between 80% and 85% with treatment, medical professionals warn that refusing therapy could be fatal. The Connecticut Supreme Court will hear the appeal this week, potentially shaping future rulings on adolescent medical autonomy. Meanwhile, DCF maintains its actions were necessary: when experts unanimously agree a child will die without intervention, protecting life becomes non-negotiable.

Annesi Jackie Fortin, Cassandra'nın bu inancını çocukluğundan beri sürdüğünü hatırlatıyor. Connecticut Çocuklar Tıp Merkezi'ndeki doktorlar tedaviyi önerdiğinde, Cassandra büyük bir stres yaşadı ve evden kaçtı. Yetkililer, bu kararı annesinin koruyucu bakımını engellediğini düşünerek onu Aile ve Çocuk Hizmetleri Dairesi (DCF) tarafından devlet koruması altına aldı. article_content: Alex Bruce says Hull City are 'quietly confident' of progressing to the Europa League play-offs despite being held to a 0-0 draw by AS Trencin in the first leg of their third qualifying round in Zilina. Hull, considered favorites on their European return, failed to break through despite numerous chances. Tom Huddlestone squandered a golden opportunity in the 61st minute, seeing his penalty saved and his follow-up strike crash against the crossbar. Bruce, who played a key role in central defense, acknowledged the physical edge Trencin held, noting they were sharper due to being into their domestic season — unlike Hull, who’ve had only friendlies as preparation. 'Friendlies don’t replicate the intensity of real matches,' Bruce told Press Association Sport. 'They were running like whippets — it leveled the playing field. But if we were at peak fitness during the season, we’d have won comfortably.' He expressed confidence in a strong performance at the KC Stadium next week, calling the away draw a useful learning experience. Though surprised Huddlestone — known for his pinpoint penalty technique — missed from the spot, Bruce remained supportive: 'Everyone thought it was going in. He just rushed the second chance. Better now than in the return leg.' Summer recruits Tom Ince and Robert Snodgrass made their debuts in the second half, and Bruce anticipates regular rotation as the campaign progresses. 'We’ll need depth this season — lots of games ahead,' he said. 'The new lads made an impact. I’d be very surprised if we see the same XI again.' In jest, Bruce added: 'I might start taking penalties myself — but if I do, we’re really in trouble.'

article_content: In the aftermath of the devastating 2008 Mumbai attacks — which claimed over 160 lives across ten locations including the iconic Taj Mahal Hotel — the only captured survivor, 21-year-old Mohammad Ajmal Kasab, has written a letter addressed to the Pakistan High Commission in New Delhi. According to Mumbai police official Rakesh Maria, the three-page letter, composed in Urdu, contains a direct confession of Kasab’s participation in the assault. The document, expected to be formally delivered soon, seeks legal support from Pakistan’s diplomatic mission. Indian investigators assert that Kasab, along with the other nine assailants, hailed from Faridkot village in Pakistan’s Punjab province. However, Pakistani authorities continue to dispute this, labeling the perpetrators as 'stateless actors' rather than state-sponsored operatives. Meanwhile, under mounting international pressure following a U.N. Security Council designation, Pakistan has shut down the charity Jamaat-ud-Dawa, long linked to the militant group Lashkar-e-Tayyiba (LeT), and placed its leader under house arrest. India maintains that LeT trained and orchestrated the Mumbai attacks, a claim that remains central to its diplomatic stance.

Hint araştırmacılar, Kasab'ın ve diğer dokuz saldırganın Pakistan'ın Punjab eyaletindeki Faridkot köyünden geldiğini iddia ediyor. Ancak Pakistanlı yetkililer bu iddiayı reddederek, saldırganları 'devletsiz aktörler' olarak tanımlıyorlar. article_content: In a surprising move, Cisco has closed down its Flip camcorder division — a product it acquired for nearly $600 million just two years ago. Back in its prime, the Flip was everywhere: simple, affordable, and perfect for quick video clips. But today, finding someone using one feels like digging through old tech relics. What killed it? Smartphones, mostly. Once iPhones and Android devices started capturing HD video out of the box, the Flip became unnecessary. Why carry a separate gadget when your phone does everything — and more? Still, the smartphone wasn’t the whole story. Cisco, a company built on networks, missed a huge chance to evolve the Flip into something connected. Imagine a Flip with Wi-Fi — letting users instantly upload videos to YouTube or Flickr right after recording. Instead, users had to plug the device into a computer. That outdated workflow felt painfully slow in an era of instant sharing. There was a real opportunity here: young users who couldn’t afford smartphones still wanted to share moments. A low-cost, internet-ready Flip with a simple social platform could’ve carved out a loyal niche. Cisco almost did it — rumors suggest a Wi-Fi model was in development — but too late. By then, Instagram and Ustream had already made smartphones the undisputed stars of mobile sharing. And the high-end Flip models? Underwhelming. The Slide HD, priced at $230, offered 720p video and 16GB storage. Meanwhile, a basic iPod Touch at the same price gave you 8GB, Wi-Fi, app support, and HD video. No contest. Had Cisco built a premium Flip with 1080p recording, optical zoom, a touchscreen, and custom video apps, it might have stood out. But instead, it stayed stuck in the past. The Flip is gone now — a casualty of innovation fatigue and corporate hesitation.
translated_content: Cisco, iki yıl önce neredeyse 600 milyon dolara satın aldığı Flip kamera bölümünü kapattı. Zirve döneminde Flip her yerdeydi: basit, ucuza ve hızlı video çekmek için idealdi. Ama bugün birinin bunu kullandığını görmek eski teknoloji parçalarını aramak gibi. Ne öldürdü onu? Akıllı telefonlar çoğunlukla. iPhone ve Android cihazları HD video çekmeye başladığında, Flip gereksiz hale geldi. Telefonunuz her şeyi yapıyor ve daha fazlasını yapıyorsa, neden ayrı bir cihaz taşıyacaksınız? Yine de akıllı telefonlar tek sebep değildi. Ağlarda uzman bir şirket olan Cisco, Flip’i bağlantılı bir cihaza dönüştürme fırsatını kaçırdı. Flip’e Wi-Fi eklerseniz, kullanıcılar videolarını kaydettikten hemen sonra YouTube veya Flickr’a yükleyebilirdi. Ama kullanıcıların bilgisayara bağlanıp dosyaları aktarması gerekirdi. Bu eski, bilgisayar merkezli bir paylaşım yöntemiydi. Şimdi insanlar, ne zaman olursa olsun, nerede olurlarsa olsun anında paylaşmak istiyorlar. Burada gerçek bir fırsat vardı: Akıllı telefon abonelikleri alamayan gençler hâlâ anları paylaşmak istiyordu. Ucuz, internete bağlı bir kamera ve özel bir sosyal platformla Flip, sadık bir kullanıcı kitlesine sahip olabilirdi. Cisco neredeyse bunu yaptı — Wi-Fi versiyonunun geliştirildiği söyleniyordu — ama çok geçti. O sırada Instagram ve Ustream, akıllı telefonları mobil paylaşımın kesin yıldızları haline getirmişti. Ve yüksek performanslı Flip modelleri? İlgisiz. 230 dolarlık Slide HD, 720p video ve 16 GB depolama sunuyordu. Aynı fiyata temel bir iPod Touch ise 8 GB depolama, Wi-Fi, uygulama desteği ve HD video sunuyordu. Karşılaştırma yoktu. Cisco, 1080p kayıt, iyi bir zoom lens, dokunmatik ekran ve Flip için özel video uygulamalarıyla premium bir Flip yapmış olsaydı, farklılaşabilirdi. Ama yerine, geçmişte takılı kaldı. Flip artık yok — yenilik yorgunluğu ve kurumsal gecikmenin bir kurbanı.

article_content: On 24 May 2013, 24-year-old zookeeper Sarah McClay tragically lost her life after being attacked by two Sumatran tigers at South Lakes Wild Animal Park in Cumbria. The incident occurred during a scheduled 'starvation day', when the animals are not fed to simulate natural hunting cycles. According to zoo owner David Gill, McClay violated essential safety procedures by entering the tiger enclosure without first confirming via radio that the animals were securely contained. Despite having worked with the tigers for over a year and being familiar with the complex gate systems designed to keep keepers and animals separated, she bypassed protocol entirely. Witnesses reported hearing a scream over the radio and rushing to the scene, where they found the male tiger, Padang — significantly larger than the female Alisha — attacking McClay. Park staff responded by firing warning shots to drive the tigers away, but McClay had already sustained severe trauma to her head and neck, leading to cardiac arrest. She was revived by paramedics but later died in hospital. In the days leading up to the tragedy, McClay updated her Facebook profile picture to a still from Disney’s 1991 animated film Beauty and the Beast — showing a painted portrait with deep claw marks. While this sparked speculation about her emotional state, police later clarified that no evidence pointed to suicide or self-harm. Instead, investigators believe she was performing routine duties in a restricted staff area when Padang unexpectedly entered through an adjacent pen. David Gill stressed that neither the park nor the tigers were responsible, emphasizing that the enclosure design and safety rules were robust and followed by all other staff. McClay’s family expressed gratitude for the medical team’s efforts and acknowledged their ongoing grief. The park closed temporarily following the incident, and authorities continue to review all aspects of the event to prevent future tragedies.

Olay, hayvanların yemek verilmediği ve doğadaki doğal avlanma döngülerini simüle etmek amacıyla uygulanan 'Açlık Günü' sırasında meydana geldi. Park sahibi David Gill'e göre, McClay, kaplanların güvenli bir şekilde kilitli olduğundan emin olmak için radyo ile izin almadan kaplan alanına girdi ve temel güvenlik prosedürlerini ihlal etti. Kaplanlarla daha fazla bir yıl boyunca çalıştı ve insanların ve hayvanların her zaman ayrı kalmasını sağlayan karmaşık kapı sistemlerini iyi tanıdığı halde, protokolü tamamen göz ardı etti. Gözlemciler, radyodan bir çığlık duyduklarını ve sahneye koştuklarını bildirdi; orada erkek kaplan Padang — dişi Alisha'dan çok daha büyük — McClay'ı saldırırken buldular. Park personeli, kaplanları uzaklaştırmak için uyarı amaçlı iki atış yaptı, ancak McClay zaten baş ve boyun bölgesinde ciddi travmalar almıştı ve kalp durması yaşadı. Ambulans ekipleri tarafından canlandırıldı ama daha sonra hastanede hayatını kaybetti. Trajedi öncesindeki günlerde, McClay Facebook profil fotoğrafını Disney'in 1991 yılında yaptığı animasyon filmi 'Beauty and the Beast'ten bir sahneyle değiştirmişti — derin pençelerle yırtılmış bir resim gösteriyordu. Bu durum duygusal durumuyla ilgili spekülasyonlara neden oldu, ancak polis daha sonra intihar veya kendine zarar verme yönünde hiçbir kanıt bulunmadığını açıkladı. Bunun yerine, araştırmacılar, McClay'ın hayvanların giremeyeceği bir personel alanındaki rutin görevlerini yaparken, Padang'ın bitişik bir ahırdan beklenmedik şekilde girdiğini düşünüyorlar. David Gill, ne parkın ne de kaplanların sorumlu olduğunu vurguladı ve kaplan alanının tasarımının ve güvenlik kurallarının sağlam olduğunu ve diğer tüm çalışanlar tarafından takip edildiğini belirtti. McClay'ın ailesi, sağlık ekiplerinin cesaretli çabalarına minnettarlığını ifade etti ve hâlâ yaşadıkları trajediyi kabullenmeye çalıştıklarını söyledi. Olayın ardından park geçici olarak kapatıldı ve yetkililer, gelecekte benzer trajedileri önlemek amacıyla olayın tüm yönlerini incelemeye devam ediyor.

article_content: These are the first images of a polar bear caring for her newborn cub at Rostock Zoo in Germany. The tiny cub, just two weeks old, can be seen climbing over its mother, Vilma, inside their birthing cave. Staff say the cub—still unnamed—was born on Vilma’s 12th birthday and is so young it has not yet opened its eyes. In one photo, Vilma lies on her back, gently resting one of her massive paws over the cub. According to German news site Rostock Heute, the father is Lars—the same male who fathered Knut, the famous captive-born cub in Berlin eight years ago. Mother and cub remain secluded in the cave, visible only through footage from an internal camera. Zoo officials confirm the birth occurred on December 3 and coincides with plans to build a new £7.85 million polar bear and penguin habitat in 2016. This is Vilma’s second litter; her first cub, Anori, was born two years ago at Wuppertal Zoo near Düsseldorf. The last polar bear births at Rostock Zoo were in 2004, when twins Venus and Valeska were born. Staff report that Vilma is caring for her cub with intense dedication, and the newborn is already gaining weight. Polar bear cubs typically weigh between 450 and 850 grams at birth and usually open their eyes between 21 and 34 days after delivery.

İki haftalık minik yavru, doğum mağarasında annesi Vilma'nın üzerinde tırmanırken görülüyor. article_content: On what turned out to be a mild Monday night in Stoke, Chelsea secured a crucial 2-0 victory, putting them at the top of the Premier League at Christmas. The Stamford Bridge club has lost just one of their last 20 Monday Premier League matches, winning 12 and drawing seven. However, they still have a long way to go to catch Manchester United, who lead the league in Monday-night wins. Despite going 14 months without a Monday fixture between August 2013 and October 2014, United have won 38 of their 55 Monday games — a 69.1% win rate. Chelsea, with 19 wins in 42 Monday matches (45.2%), trail significantly behind. Arsenal sit second with 30 wins in 55 matches (54.5%), while Manchester City are third with 27 wins in 60 (45%). Tottenham Hotspur hold the record for most Monday matches played (65), though they haven’t featured in one this season, with 26 wins (40%). West Ham have played 64 Monday games, winning 18 (28.1%). West Brom, with just two wins in 19 Monday matches (10.5%), have the lowest win percentage of any team with at least one victory. Sunderland have won five of 32 (15.6%), and Hull City remain winless in six Monday attempts. Sheffield Wednesday boast an impressive 15 wins in 24 Monday Premier League matches (62.5%), though they were relegated in 2000 and no longer compete in the top flight. The next Monday fixture is Liverpool vs. Swansea at Anfield on December 29 — Liverpool have 26 wins in 60 (43.3%), while Swansea have won just one of four (25%). West Brom manager Alan Irvine will hope to reverse his team’s dismal Monday record when they face Everton at Goodison Park on January 19.
